name: Department of Health - Abu Dhabi (simulated)
mandate:
Simulated Department of Health - Abu Dhabi, acting through its Responsible AI Standard, which applies
to the DoH and all licensed healthcare entities in the Emirate that develop, procure or deploy AI
systems (Standard 1.2). DoH conducts periodic audits and technical assessments of regulated entities
and may impose sanctions for breaches of the Standard (Standard 5-6). As a local government health
authority it is a "Health Authority" under Federal Law 2/2019 (Art. 1), the authority whose decision
prescribes when health data may be processed outside the State (Art. 13).
